character_backstory: Isk grew up in Saltmarrow, the harbour town the sea abandoned forty years ago. She runs the exposed flats at dry tide, pulling salvage out of the drowned lower district before the water comes back for a few hours each night. Her mother went out on the flats six years ago and never came back; the salvage guild wrote her down as lost and kept her share. Isk owes the guild's tallyman for a winter of credit and carries her mother's brass tide-reckoner, which has never kept true time.
custom_style: A drowned harbour town at the edge of mudflats the sea left behind. Salvage, debt and a tide that keeps the wrong hours.

special_abilities.name: Tidecount
special_abilities.description: Isk feels the water's return in her teeth: how long until the flats flood, and which channels fill first.

faction_pressure: the salvage guild and the harbour reeve
